messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

The team now has departments such as Billing and Technical Support. Let admins create, rename,
and delete groups, and add staff to more than one group. Staff can browse groups and memberships;
groups organize work, they don't hide tickets from other staff.

For example:

```http
POST /api/v1/groups

{"group":{"name":"Billing"}}
```

```http
POST /api/v1/group_memberships

{"group_membership":{"group_id":20,"user_id":12,"default":true}}
```

Use the usual list, detail, and delete routes for both resources, plus PATCH for group names.
List groups and memberships by ID ascending.
Let admins choose a staff member's default with `PUT /group_memberships/:id/make_default`.
Every staff member with memberships should have one default;
removing it should pick another remaining membership.
Filter memberships by `group_id` and `user_id`.

Tickets can now have a `group_id`, with the group's ID/name in `group`, and staff can filter the
inbox by group or `group_id=unassigned`.

An assigned person must belong to the ticket's group. Assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket
should use their default group, if they have one. Moving a ticket to another group should clear
an assignee who doesn't belong there. Clearing the assignee leaves the group in place; explicitly
clearing the group also clears the assignee. Deleting groups or memberships clears invalid assignments.
Suspension keeps memberships for later.


You can execute bash commands and edit files to implement the necessary changes.

1. Analyze the codebase by finding and reading relevant files

3. Edit the source code to resolve the issue
4. Verify your fix works by running your script again
5. Test edge cases to ensure your fix is robust
6. Submit your changes and finish your work by issuing the following command: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.

{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output_head": "# Helpdesk API

Rails API-only backend for a helpdesk SaaS. The frontend is a separate app and
talks to this service over JSON under `/api/v1`.

## Setup

```sh
export DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_development?host=/var/lib/postgresql"
bin/rails db:prepare
bin/rails server -p 3000        # Puma
```

Tests use their own database. Point `DATABASE_URL` at it for the test run:

```sh
DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_test?host=/var/lib/postgresql" RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails db:create db:schema:load
DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_test?host=/var/lib/postgresql" bin/rails test
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | none | PostgreSQL connection |
| `HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL` | `http://localhost:3001` | Base of verification, reset and invitation links, and the only CORS origin allowed |
| `HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM` | `support@example.test` | Sender address for all email |
| `HELPDESK_SUPPORT_DOMAIN` | `support.example.test` | Domain of the support addresses. A business receives mail at `SUBDOMAIN@` this domain |
| `RAILS_INBOUND_EMAIL_PASSWORD` | — | Password the SMTP relay uses to post inbound mail. Without it the relay fails with a server error and accepts nothing |
| `SMTP_ADDRESS`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` | — | Production SMTP. `SMTP_ADDRESS` is required, so production fails to boot without it |
| `SECRET_KEY_BASE` | — | Required in production by Rails 8, even though the API uses no cookies |

In development, mail is written to `tmp/mails/`.

Mail is sent through Active Job. The default `async` adapter runs jobs inside the web
process and loses queued mail if the process restarts. Configure a persistent queue
adapter before going live.

## Conventions

- Every API request is JSON. The mail relay ingress is the exception (see [Email](#email)).
  Successful responses are the resource objects. Errors look like
  `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {...}}}`.
- `X-Helpdesk-Account: <subdomain>` selects the business. Sign-in, email verification,
  password reset requests and `GET /portal` require it. Signed-in endpoints accept it
  and reject a token used with a different business (`403 wrong_account`).
- Signed-in endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Body |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/v1/account/create` | none | `{"account":{"name","subdomain","admin":{"name","email","password"}}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/sessions` | header | `{"session":{"email","password"}}` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/session` | bearer | — |
| GET | `/api/v1/me` | bearer | — |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/me` | bearer | `{"user":{"name"}}` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/me/password` | bearer | `{"password_change":{"current_password","password"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/email_verifications` | header | `{"email_verification":{"email"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm` | none | `{"email_verification":{"token"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/password_resets` | header | `{"password_reset":{"email"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/password_resets/confirm` | none | `{"password_reset":{"token","password"}}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/portal` | header | — |
| POST | `/api/v1/registrations` | header | `{"user":{"name","email","password"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitation_previews` | none | `{"invitation_preview":{"token"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitation_acceptances` | none | `{"invitation_acceptance":{"token","name","password"}}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations` | bearer, admin | — (paginated, `?status=pending\|accepted\|revoked\|expired`) |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations` | bearer, admin | `{"invitation":{"email","role":"admin\|agent"}}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations/:id` | bearer, admin | — |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations/:id/resend` | bearer, admin | — |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/invitations/:id` | bearer, admin | — |
| GET | `/api/v1/users` | bearer, admin | — (paginated, `?role=`, `?suspended=true\|false`) |
| GET | `/api/v1/users/:id` | bearer, admin | — |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/users/:id` | bearer, admin | `{"user":{"suspended":true\|false}}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/staff` | bearer, staff | — (paginated) |

# Helpdesk API

Rails API-only backend for a helpdesk SaaS. The frontend is a separate app and
talks to this service over JSON under `/api/v1`.

## Setup

```sh
export DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_development?host=/var/lib/postgresql"
bin/rails db:prepare
bin/rails server -p 3000        # Puma
```

Tests use their own database. Point `DATABASE_URL` at it for the test run:

```sh
DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_test?host=/var/lib/postgresql" RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails db:create db:schema:load
DATABASE_URL="postgresql:///helpdesk_test?host=/var/lib/postgresql" bin/rails test
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | none | PostgreSQL connection |
| `HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL` | `http://localhost:3001` | Base of verification, reset and invitation links, and the only CORS origin allowed |
| `HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM` | `support@example.test` | Sender address for all email |
| `HELPDESK_SUPPORT_DOMAIN` | `support.example.test` | Domain of the support addresses. A business receives mail at `SUBDOMAIN@` this domain |
| `RAILS_INBOUND_EMAIL_PASSWORD` | — | Password the SMTP relay uses to post inbound mail. Without it the relay fails with a server error and accepts nothing |
| `SMTP_ADDRESS`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` | — | Production SMTP. `SMTP_ADDRESS` is required, so production fails to boot without it |
| `SECRET_KEY_BASE` | — | Required in production by Rails 8, even though the API uses no cookies |

In development, mail is written to `tmp/mails/`.

Mail is sent through Active Job. The default `async` adapter runs jobs inside the web
process and loses queued mail if the process restarts. Configure a persistent queue
adapter before going live.

## Conventions

- Every API request is JSON. The mail relay ingress is the exception (see [Email](#email)).
  Successful responses are the resource objects. Errors look like
  `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {...}}}`.

  password reset requests and `GET /portal` require it. Signed-in endpoints accept it

## Requests and tickets

Customers work with **requests**, at `/api/v1/requests`. Staff work with the same records as
**tickets**, at `/api/v1/tickets`. Customers can only see their own requests. Staff can see
every request in their business. Another business's records always look missing (`404`).

- A new request is `open`. Its first comment comes with the request.
- Responses return records under `request` or `ticket`, and lists under the plural name
  (`requests`, `tickets`, `comments`). A request has `id`, `subject`, `status`,
  `requester_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`. A ticket also has the requester as
  `{id, name, email}`.

  Customers only see public comments. Comments are listed oldest first.
- A ticket also has `priority` (`normal` or `high`), `assignee_id` and `assignee` (`{id, name}`,
  or `null` when unassigned). Customers never see the priority or the assignee.
- **Customer replies** `PATCH /requests/:id` with an optional `comment` and an optional
  `status`. A customer can only set `status` to `solved`. A reply reopens a `pending` or
  `solved` request, unless the same update marks it solved. Sending neither a comment nor a
  status is a `422`.
- **Staff replies** `PATCH /tickets/:id` with an optional `comment`, an optional `status`
  (`open`, `pending` or `solved`), an optional `priority` and an optional `assignee_id`. A reply
  on its own does not change the status. Sending none of them is a `422`.

  `"normal"` puts it back. Any other value, including `null`, is a `422` (`validation_failed`,
  with the reason under `details.priority`), and nothing else in that update is saved. Customers
  cannot set priority, and a customer's request never shows it. A priority change leaves
  `updated_at` alone, so it does not move the request in the customer's list.
- **Assignment**: `{"ticket":{"assignee_id":12}}` assigns the ticket to a user, and
  `{"ticket":{"assignee_id":null}}` clears it. The assignee must be an active admin or agent
  in the same business (`422` otherwise). Use an ID from `GET /staff`.

  `updated_at`, the status and the position in the customer's list are unchanged. Assignment
  changes are internal in the same way. Only public replies and status changes count as
  customer-visible activity.
- Public staff replies on a request opened by email are also emailed to the requester. See
  [Email](#email).

`page` or `per_page` that is not a whole number of 1 or more returns `400 invalid_pagination`.
Requests and tickets are ordered by recent activity, so the request or ticket with the newest
public reply or status change comes first. Users, invitations and staff are ordered by ID,

{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output": "public reply or status change comes first. Users, invitations and staff are ordered by ID,
oldest first. An unknown filter value, such as `?status=lost`, returns `400 invalid_filter`.

**Filtering.** Staff filter `GET /tickets` with any combination of these. Every filter that is
sent must match, so `?status=open&priority=high` returns only open, high-priority tickets.

- `status` is `open`, `pending` or `solved`.
- `assignee_id` is a user ID, or `unassigned` for tickets nobody is working. Use an ID from

  # A cancelled account can be reactivated for this long. After that it is purged.

  RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = %w[api app admin www mail].freeze

            presence: true,
            length: { maximum: 63 },

            uniqueness: true
  validate :subdomain_not_reserved

  scope :cancelled_before, ->(time) { where(cancelled_at: ..time) }

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?
  end

  def reactivatable?(now: Time.current)
    cancelled? && cancelled_at > now - CANCELLATION_WINDOW
  end

  def reactivate_by
    cancelled_at + CANCELLATION_WINDOW if cancelled?
  end

  # Marks the account cancelled and signs out every user in it.

    with_lock do
      raise StateError.new("already_cancelled", "This account is already cancelled.") if cancelled?

      update!(cancelled_at: now)
      Session.where(user_id: users.select(:id)).delete_all
    end
  end

  def reactivate!(now: Time.current)
    with_lock do
      raise StateError.new("not_cancelled", "This account is not cancelled.") unless cancelled?
      raise StateError.new("reactivation_window_closed", "This account was cancelled more than 90 days ago and can no longer be reactivated.") unless reactivatable?(now: now)

      update!(cancelled_at: nil)
    end
  end

  # Permanently deletes accounts cancelled more than CANCELLATION_WINDOW ago, with
  # all their data. Returns the number of accounts deleted.
  def self.purge_cancelled!(now: Time.current)
    cutoff = now - CANCELLATION_WINDOW

    cancelled_before(cutoff).pluck(:id).count do |id|
      transaction do

        account = lock.cancelled_before(cutoff).find_by(id: id)
        next false unless account

        account.destroy!
        true
      end
    end
  end

      name: name,
      subdomain: subdomain,
      status: cancelled? ? "cancelled" : "active",
      cancelled_at: cancelled_at,
      reactivate_by: reactivate_by,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  def subdomain_not_reserved
    errors.add(:subdomain, "is reserved") if RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS.include?(subdomain)
  end

class Account < ApplicationRecord
  # A cancelled account can be reactivated for this long. After that it is purged.
  CANCELLATION_WINDOW = 90.days
  SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT = /\A[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\z/
  RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = %w[api app admin www mail].freeze

  StateError = ::StateError

  # The admin who registered the business. Only the owner can cancel or reactivate it.
  belongs_to :owner, class_name: "User", optional: true

  has_many :users, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :requests, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :invitations, dependent: :destroy

  normalizes :subdomain, with: ->(value) { value.strip.downcase }

  validates :name, presence: true, length: { maximum: 120 }
  validates :subdomain,
            presence: true,
            length: { maximum: 63 },
            format: { with: SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT, message: "may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens" },
            uniqueness: true
  validate :subdomain_not_reserved

  scope :cancelled_before, ->(time) { where(cancelled_at: ..time) }

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?
  end

  def reactivatable?(now: Time.current)
    cancelled? && cancelled_at > now - CANCELLATION_WINDOW
  end

  def reactivate_by
    cancelled_at + CANCELLATION_WINDOW if cancelled?
  end

  # Marks the account cancelled and signs out every user in it.
  def cancel!(now: Time.current)
    with_lock do
      raise StateError.new("already_cancelled", "This account is already cancelled.") if cancelled?

      update!(cancelled_at: now)
      Session.where(user_id: users.select(:id)).delete_all
    end
  end

  def reactivate!(now: Time.current)
    with_lock do
      raise StateError.new("not_cancelled", "This account is not cancelled.") unless cancelled?
      raise StateError.new("reactivation_window_closed", "This account was cancelled more than 90 days ago and can no longer be reactivated.") unless reactivatable?(now: now)

      update!(cancelled_at: nil)
    end
  end

  # Permanently deletes accounts cancelled more than CANCELLATION_WINDOW ago, with
  # all their data. Returns the number of accounts deleted.
  def self.purge_cancelled!(now: Time.current)
    cutoff = now - CANCELLATION_WINDOW

    cancelled_before(cutoff).pluck(:id).count do |id|
      transaction do
        # Re-check under a row lock: the owner may have reactivated since the scan.
        account = lock.cancelled_before(cutoff).find_by(id: id)
        next false unless account

        account.destroy!
        true
      end
    end
  end

  def as_api_json
    {
      id: id,
      name: name,
      subdomain: subdomain,
      status: cancelled? ? "cancelled" : "active",
      cancelled_at: cancelled_at,
      reactivate_by: reactivate_by,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  def subdomain_not_reserved
    errors.add(:subdomain, "is reserved") if RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS.include?(subdomain)
  end
end

# Authenticates "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" and sets @current_session,
# @current_user and @account.
module SessionAuthentication
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  private

  def authenticate_session!
    @current_session = Session.lookup(bearer_token)
    unless @current_session
      response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] = 'Bearer realm="helpdesk"'
      return render_error(401, "unauthorized", "Sign in to continue.")
    end

    @current_user = @current_session.user
    @account = @current_user.account
    return if requested_account_matches?(@account)

    render_error(403, "wrong_account", "This session belongs to a different business.")
  end

  def bearer_token
    scheme, token = request.authorization.to_s.split(" ", 2)
    token.presence if scheme.to_s.casecmp?("Bearer")
  end

  # Admins manage people and invitations.
  def require_admin!
    return if @current_user.admin?

    render_error(403, "forbidden", "Only admins can do that.")
  end

  # The owner is the admin who registered the business. Only the owner can cancel or
  # reactivate it.
  def require_owner!
    return if @current_user.owner?

    render_error(403, "forbidden", "Only the account owner can do that.")
  end

  # Staff are the owner and agents. Customers use the portal's request endpoints instead.
  def require_staff!
    return if @current_user.staff?

    render_error(403, "forbidden", "Only staff can do that.")
  end
end

# Offset pagination for list endpoints: ?page=1&per_page=25.
#
# A page or per_page that is not a whole number of 1 or more is a 400. A per_page above
# MAX_PER_PAGE is capped, and the response shows the value actually used.
module Pagination
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 25
  MAX_PER_PAGE = 100

  class InvalidPage < StandardError; end

  included do
    rescue_from InvalidPage do |error|
      render_error(400, "invalid_pagination", error.message)
    end
  end

  private

  # Returns [records, paging] for one page of the scope. `paging` is the set of fields
  # that go next to the records in the response.
  def paginate(scope)
    page = page_number(:page, default: 1)
    per_page = [page_number(:per_page, default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE].min

    count = scope.count
    offset = (page - 1) * per_page
    # Skip the query for pages past the end. This also keeps huge page numbers out of SQL.
    records = offset < count ? scope.offset(offset).limit(per_page).to_a : []

    paging = {
      count: count,
      page: page,
      per_page: per_page,
      next_page: page * per_page < count ? page + 1 : nil,
      previous_page: page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil
    }
    [records, paging]
  end

  def page_number(name, default:)
    raw = params[name]
    return default if raw.blank?

    value = Integer(raw.to_s, 10, exception: false)
    raise InvalidPage, "#{name} must be a whole number, 1 or more." if value.nil? || value < 1

    value
  end
end

# Offset pagination for list endpoints: ?page=1&per_page=25.
#
# A page or per_page that is not a whole number of 1 or more is a 400. A per_page above
# MAX_PER_PAGE is capped, and the response shows the value actually used.
module Pagination
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 25
  MAX_PER_PAGE = 100

  class InvalidPage < StandardError; end

  included do
    rescue_from InvalidPage do |error|
      render_error(400, "invalid_pagination", error.message)
    end
  end

  private

  # Returns [records, paging] for one page of the scope. `paging` is the set of fields
  # that go next to the records in the response.
  def paginate(scope)
    page = page_number(:page, default: 1)
    per_page = [page_number(:per_page, default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE].min

    count = scope.count
    offset = (page - 1) * per_page
    # Skip the query for pages past the end. This also keeps huge page numbers out of SQL.
    records = offset < count ? scope.offset(offset).limit(per_page).to_a : []

    paging = {
      count: count,
      page: page,
      per_page: per_page,
      next_page: page * per_page < count ? page + 1 : nil,
      previous_page: page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil
    }
    [records, paging]
  end

  def page_number(name, default:)
    raw = params[name]
    return default if raw.blank?

    value = Integer(raw.to_s, 10, exception: false)
    raise InvalidPage, "#{name} must be a whole number, 1 or more." if value.nil? || value < 1

    value
  end
end

messages.content:
I've read enough to design this. Here's what I found and what I plan to do.

**Current state:** A Rails 8.1 API with accounts, users with roles (`admin`/`agent`/`customer`), requests that staff see as tickets, and an existing `assignee_id` with rules that need to stay intact. The baseline suite is green (404 runs, 0 failures). Conventions I'll follow: `{error: {code, message, details}}` errors, `validation_failed` for bad bodies, `400 invalid_filter` for bad query params, and internal changes (assignment, priority, group) leaving `updated_at` alone. Business-scoped lookups return 404 for other businesses' records.

**Plan:**
1. Migrations: `groups` (unique name per business, case-insensitive), `group_memberships` (unique per group+user, and a partial unique index so each user has at most one default), and `requests.group_id` (nullify on delete).
2. Models: `Group` and `GroupMembership` hold the default-membership rules and the cleanup on delete. `Request` gets the placement rules: assignee must be in the group, moving clears a non-member assignee, assigning an ungrouped ticket uses the assignee's default group, and clearing the group clears the assignee.
3. Concurrency: take the business row lock, as suspension already does, around membership and group changes that touch assignments.
4. Controllers and routes for groups and memberships, plus `group_id` on tickets and the inbox filter.
5. Tests and README updates.

I'll start with the migrations.

# A department the business organizes its work by, such as Billing or Technical Support. Groups
# organize tickets, they do not hide them: every staff member can see every ticket.
class Group < ApplicationRecord
  NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 120

  belongs_to :account
  has_many :group_memberships, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :group

  normalizes :name, with: ->(value) { value.strip }

  validates :name,
            presence: true,
            length: { maximum: NAME_MAX_LENGTH },
            uniqueness: { scope: :account_id, case_sensitive: false }

  # Runs before the memberships are removed, so a ticket never keeps an assignee who was only
  # valid for this group.
  before_destroy :ungroup_tickets

  # Deletes the group. Its memberships go with it, and tickets in it become ungrouped. The business
  # lock serializes this with assignments, so no assignment can slip in between.
  def remove!
    account.with_lock do
      lock!
      destroy!
    end
  end

  def as_api_json
    {
      id: id,
      name: name,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  # Tickets in the group lose the group and the assignee, since the assignee was only valid for
  # this group. update_all skips timestamps: this is internal, so the tickets' updated_at stays put.
  def ungroup_tickets
    Request.where(group_id: id).update_all(group_id: nil, assignee_id: nil)
  end
end
EOF

# A staff member's place in a group. Staff can belong to several groups. A staff member with
# memberships always has exactly one default, which is the group their tickets take when they are
# assigned to a ticket that has no group yet.
class GroupMembership < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :group, inverse_of: :group_memberships
  belongs_to :user, inverse_of: :group_memberships

  validates :default, inclusion: { in: [true, false] }
  validate :user_is_staff_in_the_group_business
  validate :user_is_not_already_a_member

  # The first membership is always the default, so a staff member with memberships has one.
  before_validation :first_membership_is_default, on: :create
  before_save :make_only_default, if: :default?
  after_destroy :ensure_a_default_remains
  after_destroy :clear_assignments_in_the_group

  # Adds a staff member to a group, under the business lock, so it cannot race with a group or
  # membership being removed.
  def self.add!(group:, user:, default: false)
    group.account.with_lock do
      group.lock!
      create!(group: group, user: user, default: default)
    end
  end

  # The group a staff member's default membership is in, or nil when they have no memberships.
  def self.default_group_id_for(user_id)
    where(user_id: user_id, default: true).pick(:group_id)
  end

  # Removes the staff member from the group. Their tickets in that group are unassigned, and the
  # tickets stay in the group. If this was their default, another membership becomes the default.
  def remove!
    group.account.with_lock do
      lock!
      destroy!
    end
  end

  # Makes this the staff member's default group. Their other memberships stop being the default.
  def make_default!
    group.account.with_lock do
      lock!
      update!(default: true)
    end
  end

  def as_api_json
    {
      id: id,
      group_id: group_id,
      user_id: user_id,
      default: default?,
      group: { id: group.id, name: group.name },
      user: { id: user.id, name: user.name },
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  def first_membership_is_default
    self.default = true unless user_id && GroupMembership.exists?(user_id: user_id)
  end

  # Clears the default on the staff member's other memberships before this one takes it. The
  # partial unique index allows only one default, so the order matters.
  def make_only_default
    GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id, default: true)
                   .where.not(id: id)
                   .update_all(default: false, updated_at: Time.current)
  end

  # If the default was removed, the oldest remaining membership takes over, so the staff member
  # keeps a default while they belong to any group.
  def ensure_a_default_remains
    return if GroupMembership.exists?(user_id: user_id, default: true)

    replacement = GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id).order(:id).first
    # update_columns: a replacement is only a default flag, so no validation should block the
    # removal of the membership that was just deleted.
    replacement&.update_columns(default: true, updated_at: Time.current)
  end

  # Only this person's tickets in the group lose their assignment. The tickets stay in the group.
  def clear_assignments_in_the_group
    Request.where(group_id: group_id, assignee_id: user_id).update_all(assignee_id: nil)
  end

  # Only admins and agents can be in a group, and only in their own business.
  def user_is_staff_in_the_group_business
    return if group.nil? || user.nil?
    return if user.account_id == group.account_id && user.staff?

    errors.add(:user, "must be an admin or agent in this business")
  end

  def user_is_not_already_a_member
    return if group_id.nil? || user_id.nil?
    return unless GroupMembership.where(group_id: group_id, user_id: user_id).where.not(id: id).exists?

    errors.add(:user, "already belongs to this group")
  end
end
EOF

module Api
  module V1
    # Which staff belong to which groups. Staff can browse memberships. Admins add and remove
    # them, and choose each staff member's default group.
    class GroupMembershipsController < ApplicationController
      include Pagination

      # Whole numbers only, so "12abc" is refused rather than read as an ID.
      ID_FORMAT = /\A[0-9]+\z/

      before_action :authenticate_session!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_staff!
      before_action :require_admin!, only: %i[create make_default destroy]
      before_action :load_membership, only: %i[show make_default destroy]

      # GET /api/v1/group_memberships?group_id=20&user_id=12
      # Oldest first. Both filters are optional and combine.
      def index
        scope = @account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).order(id: :asc)
        scope = scope.where(group_id: filter_id(:group_id)) if params[:group_id].present?
        scope = scope.where(user_id: filter_id(:user_id)) if params[:user_id].present?

        records, paging = paginate(scope)
        render json: { group_memberships: records.map(&:as_api_json), **paging }
      end

      # GET /api/v1/group_memberships/:id
      def show
        render json: { group_membership: @membership.as_api_json }
      end

      # POST /api/v1/group_memberships
      # { group_membership: { group_id: 20, user_id: 12, default: true } }
      # The first group a staff member joins is their default, whatever default says.
      def create
        attrs = require_envelope(:group_membership)
        default = attrs.key?(:default) ? parse_boolean(attrs[:default]) : false
        if default.nil?
          return render_error(422, "validation_failed", "default must be true or false.",
                              details: { default: ["must be true or false"] })
        end

        group = @account.groups.find_by(id: parse_membership_id(attrs[:group_id]))
        user = @account.users.find_by(id: parse_membership_id(attrs[:user_id]))
        if group.nil? || user.nil?
          details = {}
          details[:group] = ["must be a group in this business"] if group.nil?
          details[:user] = ["must be a user in this business"] if user.nil?
          return render_error(422, "validation_failed", "Choose a group and a user in this business.", details: details)
        end

        membership = GroupMembership.add!(group: group, user: user, default: default)
        render json: { group_membership: membership.as_api_json }, status: :created
      end

      # PUT /api/v1/group_memberships/:id/make_default
      def make_default
        @membership.make_default!
        render json: { group_membership: @membership.as_api_json }
      end

      # DELETE /api/v1/group_memberships/:id
      # Their tickets in this group are unassigned, and the tickets stay in the group.
      def destroy
        @membership.remove!
        render json: { group_membership: @membership.as_api_json }
      end

      private

      def load_membership
        @membership = @account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).find_by(id: params[:id])
        render_error(404, "not_found", "No group membership has that ID.") unless @membership
      end

      # A filter value must be a whole number ID. Anything else is a 400, rather than a list that
      # looks filtered but is not.
      def filter_id(name)
        value = params[name]
        return value.to_i if value.is_a?(String) && value.match?(ID_FORMAT) && value.to_i.positive?

        raise RequestFilter::Invalid, "#{name} must be a group ID or user ID."
      end

      # A user or group ID in a body. Anything that is not a whole number becomes nil, which then
      # matches no record and is refused as not in this business.
      def parse_membership_id(value)
        id = parse_optional_id(value)
        id.is_a?(Integer) ? id : nil
      end
    end
  end
end

require "test_helper"

# Groups are the departments the business works in. Staff browse them. Admins create, rename and
# delete them. Deleting a group ungroups its tickets and removes its memberships.
class GroupsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    @owner_session = owner_session
    @owner_token = @owner_session.dig("session", "token")
    @owner_id = @owner_session.dig("user", "id")
    @agent_session = invited_session!(admin_token: @owner_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    @agent_token = @agent_session.dig("session", "token")
    @agent_id = @agent_session.dig("user", "id")
    @avery_session = customer_session
    @avery_token = @avery_session.dig("session", "token")
  end

  def create_group!(name, token: @owner_token)
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: name } }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
    assert_response :created, response.body
    json.fetch("group")
  end

  # --- Creating, renaming and deleting (admins only) --------------------------------

  test "an admin creates a group, and the name is trimmed" do
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "  Billing  " } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :created
    group = json.fetch("group")
    assert_equal "Billing", group["name"]
    assert group["id"].present?
    assert_equal Group.find(group["id"]).name, "Billing"
  end

  test "an admin renames a group with PATCH" do
    group = create_group!("Billing")

    patch "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", params: { group: { name: "Accounts" } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "Accounts", json.dig("group", "name")
    assert_equal "Accounts", Group.find(group["id"]).name
  end

  test "an admin deletes a group" do
    group = create_group!("Billing")

    delete "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal group["id"], json.dig("group", "id")
    assert_nil Group.find_by(id: group["id"])
  end

  test "agents and customers cannot create, rename or delete groups" do
    group = create_group!("Billing")

    [@agent_token, @avery_token].each do |token|
      post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Sales" } }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
      assert_response :forbidden

      patch "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", params: { group: { name: "Renamed" } }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
      assert_response :forbidden

      delete "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", headers: bearer(token)
      assert_response :forbidden
    end

    assert_equal "Billing", group.fetch("name") && Group.find(group["id"]).name
  end

  test "a blank or missing name is refused" do
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "   " } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "name").present?

    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: {} }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal 0, Group.count
  end

  test "a name that is not text is refused rather than crashing" do
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: { nested: "Billing" } } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "name").present?
  end

  test "a name over 120 characters is refused" do
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "x" * 121 } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "name").present?
  end

  test "group names are unique within a business, ignoring case" do
    create_group!("Billing")

    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "billing" } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "name").present?
  end

  test "another business can use the same group name" do
    create_group!("Billing")
    signup!(subdomain: "globex", name: "Globex", email: "jo@globex.test")
    verify_email!(email: "jo@globex.test", subdomain: "globex")
    globex_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "globex", email: "jo@globex.test").dig("session", "token")

    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Billing" } }, headers: bearer(globex_token), as: :json

  test "renaming without a name is refused, and a rename to a taken name is refused" do
    billing = create_group!("Billing")

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "name").present?

    patch "/api/v1/groups/#{billing['id']}", params: { group: { name: "support" } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal "Billing", Group.find(billing["id"]).name
  end

  test "a group's name is required in the envelope" do
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { name: "Billing" }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_equal "parameter_missing", json.dig("error", "code")
  end

  # --- Browsing (staff) --------------------------------------------------------------

  test "staff list groups by ID ascending, with pagination" do
    first = create_group!("Billing")
    second = create_group!("Technical Support")
    third = create_group!("Sales")

    get "/api/v1/groups", headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [first["id"], second["id"], third["id"]], json.fetch("groups").map { |group| group["id"] }
    assert_equal 3, json["count"]
    assert_equal 1, json["page"]
    assert_nil json["next_page"]
  end

  test "groups are paginated" do
    3.times { |i| create_group!("Group #{i}") }

    get "/api/v1/groups", params: { per_page: 2 }, headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_equal 2, json.fetch("groups").size
    assert_equal 2, json["next_page"]
  end

  test "staff show one group, and a group from another business is not found" do
    group = create_group!("Billing")

    get "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal({ "id" => group["id"], "name" => "Billing" }, json.fetch("group").slice("id", "name"))

    get "/api/v1/groups/999999", headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_response :not_found
    assert_equal "not_found", json.dig("error", "code")

    signup!(subdomain: "globex", name: "Globex", email: "jo@globex.test")
    verify_email!(email: "jo@globex.test", subdomain: "globex")
    globex_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "globex", email: "jo@globex.test").dig("session", "token")
    get "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", headers: bearer(globex_token)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "customers cannot list or show groups" do
    group = create_group!("Billing")

    get "/api/v1/groups", headers: bearer(@avery_token)
    assert_response :forbidden

    get "/api/v1/groups/#{group['id']}", headers: bearer(@avery_token)
    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  # --- Deleting clears what depended on the group -------------------------------------

  test "deleting a group removes its memberships and ungroups its tickets, clearing their assignee" do
    billing = create_group!("Billing")
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships",
         params: { group_membership: { group_id: billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id } },
         headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :created
    opened = open_request!(@avery_token)
    patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{opened['id']}", params: { ticket: { group_id: billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id } },
          headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    updated_at = Request.find(opened["id"]).updated_at

    travel 1.hour do
      delete "/api/v1/groups/#{billing['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)
    end

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil Group.find_by(id: billing["id"])
    assert_equal 0, GroupMembership.where(group_id: billing["id"]).count
    ticket = Request.find(opened["id"])
    assert_nil ticket.group_id
    assert_nil ticket.assignee_id
    assert_equal updated_at.to_i, ticket.updated_at.to_i
  end
end

require "test_helper"

# Memberships put staff in groups. Each staff member with memberships has exactly one default.
# Staff can browse memberships. Admins add, remove and choose defaults.
class GroupMembershipsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    @owner_session = owner_session
    @owner_token = @owner_session.dig("session", "token")
    @owner_id = @owner_session.dig("user", "id")
    @agent_session = invited_session!(admin_token: @owner_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    @agent_token = @agent_session.dig("session", "token")
    @agent_id = @agent_session.dig("user", "id")
    @avery_session = customer_session
    @avery_token = @avery_session.dig("session", "token")
    @avery_id = @avery_session.dig("user", "id")

    @billing = create_group!("Billing")
    @support = create_group!("Technical Support")
  end

  def create_group!(name, token: @owner_token)
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: name } }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
    assert_response :created, response.body
    json.fetch("group")
  end

  def add_member(group_id:, user_id:, default: nil, token: @owner_token)
    body = { group_id: group_id, user_id: user_id }
    body[:default] = default unless default.nil?
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: body }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
  end

  def add_member!(**options)
    add_member(**options)
    assert_response :created, response.body
    json.fetch("group_membership")
  end

  def defaults_for(user_id)
    GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id, default: true).pluck(:group_id)
  end

  # --- Adding staff to groups ----------------------------------------------------------

  test "an admin adds staff to a group, and the membership shows the group and the person" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    assert_equal @billing["id"], membership["group_id"]
    assert_equal @agent_id, membership["user_id"]
    assert_equal({ "id" => @billing["id"], "name" => "Billing" }, membership["group"])
    assert_equal({ "id" => @agent_id, "name" => "Sam" }, membership["user"])
  end

  test "the first membership a staff member gets is their default, even without asking" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    assert_equal true, membership["default"]
  end

  test "a staff member can belong to more than one group, and only the first is the default" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    second = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    assert_equal false, second["default"]
    assert_equal [@billing["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
  end

  test "joining a group as the default moves the default off the previous group" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    second = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true)

    assert_equal true, second["default"]
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
  end

  test "a staff member's default is one group at a time, even if an admin joins them again as default" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true)

    assert_equal 1, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @agent_id, default: true).count
  end

  test "a membership can be a default for an admin too" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @owner_id)

    assert_equal true, membership["default"]
    assert_equal [@billing["id"]], defaults_for(@owner_id)
  end

  test "the same person cannot join the same group twice" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "user").present?
    assert_equal 1, GroupMembership.where(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id).count
  end

  test "customers cannot be put in groups" do
    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @avery_id)

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "user").present?
    assert_equal 0, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @avery_id).count
  end

  test "a group or user from another business is refused, with the same message as a missing one" do
    signup!(subdomain: "globex", name: "Globex", email: "jo@globex.test")
    globex_id = Account.find_by!(subdomain: "globex").users.first.id
    globex_group = Account.find_by!(subdomain: "globex").groups.create!(name: "Sales")

    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: globex_id)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    other_business = json.dig("error", "details", "user")

    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: 999_999)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal other_business, json.dig("error", "details", "user")

    add_member(group_id: globex_group.id, user_id: @agent_id)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group").present?

    add_member(group_id: 999_999, user_id: @agent_id)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group").present?
  end

  test "a membership needs a group and a user, and a whole-number ID" do
    add_member(group_id: "12abc", user_id: @agent_id)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group").present?

    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: nil)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "user").present?
  end

  test "default must be true or false" do
    add_member(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: "yes")

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "default").present?
    assert_equal 0, GroupMembership.count
  end

  test "a membership without an envelope is a 400" do
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: "nope" }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_equal "parameter_missing", json.dig("error", "code")
  end

  # --- Choosing the default --------------------------------------------------------------

  test "an admin makes a different group the default, and only one stays the default" do
    billing = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    support = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{support['id']}/make_default", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json.dig("group_membership", "default")
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
    assert_equal false, GroupMembership.find(billing["id"]).default?
  end

  test "making the current default the default again changes nothing" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}/make_default", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [@billing["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
  end

  test "agents cannot choose a default" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}/make_default", headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "making a membership default for a missing ID is a 404" do
    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/999999/make_default", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :not_found
    assert_equal "not_found", json.dig("error", "code")
  end

  # --- Removing memberships --------------------------------------------------------------

  test "removing the default picks another remaining membership as the default" do
    billing = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    support = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    assert_equal [@billing["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)

    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{billing['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil GroupMembership.find_by(id: billing["id"])
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
    assert_equal support["id"], GroupMembership.find_by!(user_id: @agent_id, default: true).id
  end

  test "removing the default picks the oldest remaining membership when there are several" do
    billing = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    third_group = create_group!("Sales")
    add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    add_member!(group_id: third_group["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{billing['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
  end

  test "removing a non-default membership leaves the default where it is" do
    billing = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    support = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{support['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [@billing["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
    assert_equal billing["id"], GroupMembership.find_by!(user_id: @agent_id, default: true).id
  end

  test "removing the last membership leaves the staff member with no default, and no error" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 0, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @agent_id).count
  end

  test "agents cannot remove memberships" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}", headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :forbidden
    assert GroupMembership.exists?(membership["id"])
  end

  test "removing a missing membership is a 404" do
    delete "/api/v1/group_memberships/999999", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :not_found
  end

  # --- Browsing (staff) --------------------------------------------------------------------

  test "staff list memberships by ID ascending, with the filters combined" do
    first = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    second = add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    third = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @owner_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [first["id"], second["id"], third["id"]], json.fetch("group_memberships").map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal 3, json["count"]

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_id: @billing["id"] }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [first["id"], third["id"]], json.fetch("group_memberships").map { |m| m["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { user_id: @agent_id }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [first["id"], second["id"]], json.fetch("group_memberships").map { |m| m["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id },
                                     headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [first["id"]], json.fetch("group_memberships").map { |m| m["id"] }
  end

  test "a filter that matches nothing is an empty list, not an error" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_id: 999_999 }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], json.fetch("group_memberships")
    assert_equal 0, json["count"]
  end

  test "a membership filter that is not a whole number ID is a 400" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    ["12abc", "0", "1.5", "unassigned", "-3"].each do |value|
      get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_id: value }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
      assert_response :bad_request, value
      assert_equal "invalid_filter", json.dig("error", "code"), value
      assert_match(/group_id/, json.dig("error", "message"))
    end

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { user_id: "abc" }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_match(/user_id/, json.dig("error", "message"))
  end

  test "a blank membership filter counts as not sent" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_id: "", user_id: "" }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 1, json["count"]
  end

  test "staff show one membership, and a membership from another business is not found" do
    membership = add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}", headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal membership["id"], json.dig("group_membership", "id")

    signup!(subdomain: "globex", name: "Globex", email: "jo@globex.test")
    verify_email!(email: "jo@globex.test", subdomain: "globex")
    globex_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "globex", email: "jo@globex.test").dig("session", "token")
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{membership['id']}", headers: bearer(globex_token)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "customers cannot browse memberships" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", headers: bearer(@avery_token)

    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "memberships are paginated" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { per_page: 1, page: 2 }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 1, json.fetch("group_memberships").size
    assert_equal 2, json["count"]
    assert_nil json["next_page"]
    assert_equal 1, json["previous_page"]
  end

  # --- Suspension keeps memberships ----------------------------------------------------------

  test "suspending a staff member keeps their memberships, and restoring them keeps the default" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)
    add_member!(group_id: @support["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true)

    patch "/api/v1/users/#{@agent_id}", params: { user: { suspended: true } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 2, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @agent_id).count
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)

    patch "/api/v1/users/#{@agent_id}", params: { user: { suspended: false } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { user_id: @agent_id }, headers: bearer(@owner_token)
    assert_equal 2, json["count"]
    assert_equal [@support["id"]], defaults_for(@agent_id)
  end

  # --- Removing a membership clears assignments in that group --------------------------

  test "removing a membership unassigns that person's tickets in the group, but keeps the tickets in the group" do
    add_member!(group_id: @billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id)

require "test_helper"

# Tickets can be worked in a group. An assignee must belong to the ticket's group. Groups organize
# tickets, they never hide them, and moving or clearing a group keeps the assignments consistent.
class TicketGroupsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    @owner_session = owner_session
    @owner_token = @owner_session.dig("session", "token")
    @owner_id = @owner_session.dig("user", "id")
    @agent_session = invited_session!(admin_token: @owner_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    @agent_token = @agent_session.dig("session", "token")
    @agent_id = @agent_session.dig("user", "id")
    @second_agent_session = invited_session!(admin_token: @owner_token, email: "ivy@example.test", role: "agent",
                                             password: "my-team-password")
    @second_agent_id = @second_agent_session.dig("user", "id")
    avery = customer_session
    @avery_token = avery.dig("session", "token")

    @billing = create_group!("Billing")
    @support = create_group!("Technical Support")
  end

  def create_group!(name)
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: name } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :created, response.body
    json.fetch("group")
  end

  def join!(group, user_id, default: nil)
    body = { group_id: group.fetch("id"), user_id: user_id }
    body[:default] = default unless default.nil?
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: body }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :created, response.body
  end

  def staff_patch(id, ticket, token: @owner_token)
    patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{id}", params: { ticket: ticket }, headers: bearer(token), as: :json
  end

  def ticket_for(id, token: @owner_token)
    get "/api/v1/tickets/#{id}", headers: bearer(token)
    assert_response :ok, response.body
    json.fetch("ticket")
  end

  def open_ticket
    open_request!(@avery_token, subject: "Invoice wrong")
  end

  # --- Placing tickets in groups ---------------------------------------------------------

  test "a ticket starts ungrouped, and shows its group as null" do
    ticket = ticket_for(open_ticket["id"])

    assert_nil ticket["group_id"]
    assert_nil ticket["group"]
  end

  test "a staff member puts a ticket in a group, and the ticket shows the group's ID and name" do
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @billing["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_equal({ "id" => @billing["id"], "name" => "Billing" }, json.dig("ticket", "group"))
  end

  test "a group can be chosen with a numeric string" do
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"].to_s })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @billing["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
  end

  test "a group ID that is not a whole number is refused, so it cannot quietly pick another group" do
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: "#{@billing['id']}abc" })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group_id").present?
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
  end

  test "a group from another business is refused" do
    signup!(subdomain: "globex", name: "Globex", email: "jo@globex.test")
    globex_group = Account.find_by!(subdomain: "globex").groups.create!(name: "Sales")
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: globex_group.id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group").present?
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
  end

  test "a group that does not exist is refused" do
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: 999_999 })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group").present?
  end

  test "a group change alone counts as an update, and leaves updated_at and the customer's view alone" do
    opened = open_ticket
    updated_at = Request.find(opened["id"]).updated_at

    travel 1.hour do
      staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })
    end

    assert_response :ok
    request = Request.find(opened["id"])
    assert_equal updated_at.to_i, request.updated_at.to_i
    get "/api/v1/requests/#{opened['id']}", headers: bearer(@avery_token)
    assert_no_match(/group/, response.body)
  end

  test "a customer cannot see a ticket's group" do
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    get "/api/v1/requests", headers: bearer(@avery_token)

    assert_no_match(/group/, response.body)
  end

  test "a customer cannot put a ticket in a group" do
    opened = open_ticket

    patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{opened['id']}", params: { ticket: { group_id: @billing["id"] } },
          headers: bearer(@avery_token), as: :json

    assert_response :forbidden
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
  end

  # --- Assignees must belong to the ticket's group --------------------------------------

  test "an assignee must belong to the ticket's group" do
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "assignee").present?
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
  end

  test "an assignee who belongs to the ticket's group can be assigned" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_equal @billing["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
  end

  test "assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket puts it in their default group" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    join!(@support, @agent_id, default: true)
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_equal @support["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_equal @support["id"], Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
  end

  test "assigning someone with no groups to an ungrouped ticket leaves the ticket ungrouped" do
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
  end

  test "assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket, while choosing a group, must match that group" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    join!(@support, @agent_id, default: true)
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @billing["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
  end

  test "an assignment that does not match the chosen group is refused" do
    join!(@support, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "assignee").present?
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
  end

  test "assigning someone who is not in the ticket's group keeps the old assignee, as a refused update changes nothing" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    join!(@billing, @second_agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @owner_id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal @agent_id, Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
  end

  # --- Moving a ticket to another group ------------------------------------------------

  test "moving a ticket to another group clears an assignee who does not belong there" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @support["id"] })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @support["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
  end

  test "moving a ticket keeps an assignee who belongs to the new group" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    join!(@support, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @support["id"] })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @support["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
  end

  test "moving a ticket into a group with an explicit assignee who is in it is allowed" do
    join!(@support, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @support["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_equal @support["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
  end

  test "moving a ticket to a group an explicit assignee is not in is refused" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @support["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal @billing["id"], Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
  end

  test "a move that keeps the same group changes nothing about the assignee" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
  end

  # --- Clearing the assignee and the group ----------------------------------------------

  test "clearing the assignee leaves the group in place" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: nil })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_equal @billing["id"], json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
  end

  test "clearing the group also clears the assignee" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: nil })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
  end

  test "clearing the group and assigning someone in the same update is refused, not guessed at" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: nil, assignee_id: @agent_id })

    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json.dig("error", "details", "group_id").present?
    assert_equal @billing["id"], Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
  end

  test "clearing both the group and the assignee in one update is allowed" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: nil, assignee_id: nil })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "group_id")
    assert_nil json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
  end

  test "an assignment with a private note saves both, and the group is recorded" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })

    staff_patch(opened["id"], { assignee_id: @agent_id, comment: { body: "Taking this.", public: false } })

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal @agent_id, json.dig("ticket", "assignee_id")
    assert_equal 2, Request.find(opened["id"]).comments.count
  end

  # --- Suspension and memberships ----------------------------------------------------------

  test "suspending an assignee unassigns the ticket but keeps the group, and restoring keeps their memberships" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    patch "/api/v1/users/#{@agent_id}", params: { user: { suspended: true } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json

    assert_response :ok
    assert_nil Request.find(opened["id"]).assignee_id
    assert_equal @billing["id"], Request.find(opened["id"]).group_id
    assert_equal 1, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @agent_id).count

    patch "/api/v1/users/#{@agent_id}", params: { user: { suspended: false } }, headers: bearer(@owner_token), as: :json
    assert_equal 1, GroupMembership.where(user_id: @agent_id).count
  end

  # --- Filtering the inbox by group -----------------------------------------------------

  test "staff filter the inbox by group, and by unassigned groups" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    in_billing = open_ticket
    staff_patch(in_billing["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"] })
    in_support = open_request!(@avery_token, subject: "Login")
    staff_patch(in_support["id"], { group_id: @support["id"] })
    ungrouped = open_request!(@avery_token, subject: "Refund")

    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: @billing["id"] }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [in_billing["id"]], json.fetch("tickets").map { |t| t["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: "unassigned" }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [ungrouped["id"]], json.fetch("tickets").map { |t| t["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: @support["id"], status: "open" }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
    assert_equal [in_support["id"]], json.fetch("tickets").map { |t| t["id"] }
  end

  test "a group filter that matches no ticket is an empty list" do
    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: 999_999 }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], json.fetch("tickets")
  end

  test "a malformed group filter is a 400 that names the parameter" do
    ["12abc", "0", "1.5", "none"].each do |value|
      get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: value }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)
      assert_response :bad_request, value
      assert_equal "invalid_filter", json.dig("error", "code"), value
      assert_match(/group_id/, json.dig("error", "message"))
    end
  end

  test "customers cannot filter by group" do
    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { group_id: @billing["id"] }, headers: bearer(@avery_token)

    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_equal "invalid_filter", json.dig("error", "code")
  end

  test "the group filter is in the list of filters a ticket list supports" do
    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { group_id: "unassigned", assignee_id: "unassigned" }, headers: bearer(@agent_token)

    assert_response :ok
  end

  # --- Deleting a membership and a group ------------------------------------------------

  test "deleting a group ungroups its tickets, and they then stay assigned to no one" do
    join!(@billing, @agent_id)
    opened = open_ticket
    staff_patch(opened["id"], { group_id: @billing["id"], assignee_id: @agent_id })

    delete "/api/v1/groups/#{@billing['id']}", headers: bearer(@owner_token)

    assert_response :ok
    ticket = ticket_for(opened["id"])
    assert_nil ticket["group_id"]
    assert_nil ticket["assignee_id"]
  end
end

require "test_helper"

# The invariants behind group memberships. The API tests cover the requests; these check the rules
# hold below the API too, including in the database.
class GroupMembershipTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @account = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", owner: nil)
    @agent = @account.users.create!(name: "Sam", email: "sam@acme.test", password: "my-team-password",
                                    role: "agent", verified_at: Time.current)
    @customer = @account.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@acme.test", password: "my-customer-password",
                                       role: "customer", verified_at: Time.current)
    @billing = @account.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    @support = @account.groups.create!(name: "Technical Support")
  end

  def defaults_for(user)
    GroupMembership.where(user: user, default: true).pluck(:group_id)
  end

  test "the database allows only one default per staff member" do
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent)

    assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique) do
      GroupMembership.insert_all!([{ group_id: @billing.id, user_id: @agent.id, default: true,
                                    created_at: Time.current, updated_at: Time.current }])
    end
  end

  test "the database allows only one membership per group and staff member" do
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)

    assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique) do
      GroupMembership.insert_all!([{ group_id: @billing.id, user_id: @agent.id, default: false,
                                    created_at: Time.current, updated_at: Time.current }])
    end
  end

  test "the first membership is the default, and later ones are not unless asked" do
    first = GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    second = GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent)

    assert first.default?
    refute second.default?
  end

  test "a membership asked to be default takes the default from the others" do
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    support = GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent, default: true)

    assert support.default?
    assert_equal [@support.id], defaults_for(@agent)
  end

  test "a staff member's first membership is the default even when default is false" do
    membership = GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent, default: false)

    assert membership.default?
  end

  test "the oldest remaining membership becomes the default when the default is removed" do
    billing = GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    third = @account.groups.create!(name: "Sales")
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent)
    GroupMembership.add!(group: third, user: @agent)

    billing.remove!

    assert_equal [@support.id], defaults_for(@agent)
  end

  test "making a membership the default twice is harmless" do
    membership = GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)

    membership.make_default!
    membership.make_default!

    assert_equal [@billing.id], defaults_for(@agent)
  end

  test "a customer cannot be put in a group" do
    error = assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid) do
      GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @customer)
    end

    assert error.record.errors[:user].present?
  end

  test "a membership cannot join a group from another business" do
    other = Account.create!(name: "Globex", subdomain: "globex")
    other_group = other.groups.create!(name: "Sales")

    error = assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid) do
      GroupMembership.add!(group: other_group, user: @agent)
    end

    assert error.record.errors[:user].present?
  end

  test "a membership removed from a group unassigns the person's tickets in it, and no others" do
    avery = @account.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "ivy@acme.test", password: "my-customer-password",
                                   role: "customer", verified_at: Time.current)
    in_billing = Request.submit!(requester: avery, subject: "Invoice", body: "Wrong")
    in_billing.staff_reply!(author: @agent, group_id: @billing.id, assignee_id: @agent.id)
    elsewhere = Request.submit!(requester: avery, subject: "Login", body: "Broken")
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent)
    elsewhere.staff_reply!(author: @agent, group_id: @support.id, assignee_id: @agent.id)

    GroupMembership.find_by!(group: @billing, user: @agent).remove!

    assert_nil in_billing.reload.assignee_id
    assert_equal @billing.id, in_billing.group_id
    assert_equal @agent.id, elsewhere.reload.assignee_id
  end

  test "destroying an account with groups and memberships removes them all" do
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @billing, user: @agent)
    GroupMembership.add!(group: @support, user: @agent)
    @account.cancel!(now: 100.days.ago)

    travel_to Time.current do
      assert_equal 1, Account.purge_cancelled!
    end

    assert_equal 0, Group.where(account_id: @account.id).count
    assert_equal 0, GroupMembership.count

I'll run a small stress script in the development database. It runs threads that assign, move, and remove memberships at the same time, then checks the core invariant and watches for deadlocks.

arguments.command:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/race.rb <<'RBEOF'
require "benchmark"
suffix = SecureRandom.hex(3)
account = Account.create!(name: "Race #{suffix}", subdomain: "race#{suffix}")
owner = account.users.create!(name: "Owner", email: "o#{suffix}@x.test", password: "my-team-password", role: "admin", verified_at: Time.current)
account.update!(owner: owner)
agent = account.users.create!(name: "Agent", email: "a#{suffix}@x.test", password: "my-team-password", role: "agent", verified_at: Time.current)
customer = account.users.create!(name: "Cust", email: "c#{suffix}@x.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer", verified_at: Time.current)
g1 = account.groups.create!(name: "G1")
g2 = account.groups.create!(name: "G2")
GroupMembership.add!(group: g1, user: owner)
GroupMembership.add!(group: g2, user: agent)
ticket = Request.submit!(requester: customer, subject: "Race", body: "x")
errors = Queue.new
deadlocks = Queue.new
run = ->(name, n, &blk) {
  Thread.new do
    n.times do
      begin
        blk.call
      rescue ActiveRecord::Deadlocked => e
        deadlocks << "#{name}: #{e.message[0, 80]}"
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid, ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, StateError => e
        # Expected: refusals while the state changes under us.
        errors << e.class.name
      end
    end
  ensure
    ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.release_connection
  end
}
threads = []
threads << run.("assign", 40) do
  t = Request.find(ticket.id)
  t.staff_reply!(author: owner, assignee_id: agent.id) rescue nil
end
threads << run.("move", 40) do
  t = Request.find(ticket.id)
  t.staff_reply!(author: owner, group_id: [g1.id, g2.id].sample) rescue nil
end
threads << run.("membership", 40) do
  m = GroupMembership.find_by(group: g1, user: agent)
  if m then m.remove! rescue nil else GroupMembership.add!(group: g1, user: agent) rescue nil end
end
threads << run.("group-delete-recreate", 10) do
  grp = account.groups.find_by(name: "G3")
  if grp then grp.remove! rescue nil else account.groups.create!(name: "G3") rescue nil end
end
threads.each(&:join)
t = Request.find(ticket.id)
bad = t.group_id && t.assignee_id && !GroupMembership.exists?(group_id: t.group_id, user_id: t.assignee_id)
puts "final: group=#{t.group_id.inspect} assignee=#{t.assignee_id.inspect} invariant_ok=#{!bad}"
puts "deadlocks=#{deadlocks.size} #{deadlocks.size.times.map { deadlocks.pop }.first(3).inspect}"
puts "expected refusals=#{errors.size}"
account.destroy!
puts "cleaned up"
RBEOF
